traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Wikipedia, Sciadopitys verticillata (read 2026-10-16): needle-like cladodes in umbrella-like whorls at branch ends.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Wikipedia, Sciadopitys verticillata (read 2026-10-16): the whorls are crowded clusters of cladodes rather than true nodes; the underlying scale leaves are spiral (our addition, medium confidence). Prevents inheriting 'decussate'.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Wikipedia, Sciadopitys verticillata (read 2026-10-16): slow-growing evergreen conifer. (Inherited 'evergreen usually' already right; optional.)
